mapper.update: update t_device set device_status = #{deviceStatus}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = now() where id = #{deviceId}

update t_device
device_status = #{deviceStatus},
device_charge = #{deviceCharge},
device_charge_acct = #{deviceChargeAcct},
expire_date = #{expireDate}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = now()
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select td.id as id, td.device_no as deviceNo, td.device_name as deviceName, td.device_status as deviceStatus, td.device_charge as deviceCharge, td.device_charge_acct as deviceChargeAcct, td.expire_date as expireDate, td.del_flag as delFlag, td.created_by as createdBy, td.created_time as createdTime, td.updated_by as updatedBy, td.updated_time as updatedTime from t_device td inner join T_device_detail tdd on td.id = tdd.device_id where (tdd.device_imei = #{deviceNo} or tdd.device_serial_no = #{deviceNo}) and td.del_flag = 'N' limit 1

select td.id as deviceId, td.device_no as deviceNo, td.device_name as deviceName, td.device_charge as deviceCharge, td.device_charge_acct as deviceChargeAcct, td.expire_date as expireDate, tdd.device_type as deviceType, tdd.device_brand as deviceBrand, tdd.device_model as deviceModel, tdd.device_system as deviceSystem, tdd.device_system_version as deviceSystemVersion, tdd.device_login_user as deviceLoginUser, tdd.device_login_key as deviceLoginKey, tdd.device_imei as deviceImei, tdd.device_serial_no as deviceSerialNo, tdd.device_resolution as deviceResolution, tdd.device_color as deviceColor, tdd.device_size as deviceSize, tdd.device_accessory as deviceAccessory, tdd.device_remark as deviceRemark, td.created_time as createdTime, td.updated_time as updatedTime from t_device td left join t_device_detail tdd on td.id = tdd.device_id where td.id = #{deviceId}

select td.id as id, td.device_no as deviceNo, td.device_name as deviceName, td.device_status as deviceStatus, td.device_charge as deviceCharge, td.device_charge_acct as deviceChargeAcct, td.expire_date as expireDate, td.del_flag as delFlag, td.created_by as createdBy, td.created_time as createdTime, td.updated_by as updatedBy, td.updated_time as updatedTime from t_device td where td.del_flag = 'N' and td.device_status != 'abandoned' and td.updated_time < #{updateRemindTime}
